Formal statistical analyses from **Math 325 (Intermediate Statistics)** and **Math 326 (Design of Experiments)**. Each one states its hypotheses, checks the model's assumptions, and explains the results in plain language. The two experiments were designed, run, and measured by me.

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
More work from these courses, including Math 221D unit notebooks, practice quizzes, and class activities, is in the [coursework folder on GitHub](https://github.com/CrampsP/CrampsP.github.io/tree/main/Statistical_Analysis/coursework).
